mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and fall in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) indicates demand-supply mismatch and economic fragility, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 AND INDPRO < 105 occurs but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates strong manufacturing output and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 105 but 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals elevated inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 240 but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5% occurs but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) reflect robust consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 450000 but 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases.
